references.evidence: A visibly puckered/gathered sleeve crown set into a flat, padless shoulder with the allowance pressed toward the sleeve is the defining signature of shirt-style (spalla camicia) insertion, matching the label 'Neapolitan (Spalla Camicia)' and the description 'shirt-shoulder insertion, minimal structure'. There is no raised rope or built-up wadding along the seam, which rules out con rollino / roped sleevehead.
